      <h1>Kite Camp in Kalpitiya<br /><em>Rustic. Authentic. Alive.</em></h1>
      <p class="bc-hero-sub">Five wooden bungalows, open-air tropical showers and the most genuine kite camp atmosphere in Sri Lanka. Wake up. Walk to the lagoon. Kite until sunset.</p>

      <div class="bc-intro-text">
        <span class="bc-eyebrow" style="color:var(--gold);">The best kite camp in Sri Lanka</span>
        <h2>Authentic Kitesurfing Camp in Kalpitiya</h2>
        <p>Margarita Village is a <strong>small, rustic kite camp in Kalpitiya</strong> built day by day with heart and soul. Five charming tropical bungalows, open-air showers under the coconut trees, friendly animals roaming the gardens and a community of kite lovers from across the world.</p>  
        <p>You are not going to find luxury here. You are going to find <strong>real smiles, happy people and the kind of atmosphere that makes you extend your stay by two weeks</strong>. We welcome you to our little paradise.</p>  
        <p>The camp is part of the <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com" target="_blank" style="color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;">Margarita Kite School</a> ecosystem — guests walk or cycle 10 minutes to the kite center every morning, where the whole community gathers when the wind picks up. On rest days, explore <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/things-to-do-in-kalpitiya/" style="color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;">things to do in Kalpitiya</a> — <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/yoga-in-kalpitiya/" style="color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;">yoga</a>, <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/kalpitiya-dolphin-watching/" style="color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;">dolphin watching</a>, deserted islands and more.</p>  
        <ul>
          <li>5 rustic wooden bungalows</li>

  <section class="bc-bathroom">
    <div class="bc-bathroom-text">
      <span class="bc-eyebrow">The signature experience</span>
      <h2>Open-Air Showers Under Coconut Trees</h2>
      <p>This is the detail that guests talk about more than anything else. Returning from a long session on the lagoon, stepping into an <strong>open-air shower surrounded by tropical forest</strong>, watching the biodiversity above your head while the warm water washes the salt away.</p>  
      <p>After a shower, swing in one of the hammocks with a cold drink. Pick a book from our shelf. Or just sit and watch the ducks wander through the garden. There is a reason people extend their stays.</p>  
      <p>This is not a hotel. This is <strong>an experience you will still be talking about years from now</strong>.</p>

        <h2>Location — Setthawadiya, Kalpitiya</h2>
        <p>The camp sits in the Setthawadiya neighbourhood, between Kalpitiya town and the main kite spot. Close enough to everything, quiet enough to feel like you've escaped.</p>  
        <ul class="bc-loc-items">
          <li class="bc-loc-item">
            <span class="bc-loc-num">1</span>
<div class="bc-loc-body"><strong>5 min by bike to Kite Center</strong> — bikes available at the camp. 10 min on foot. The whole community gathers at the <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com/kite-school-in-sri-lanka/" target="_blank" style="color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;">kite school on the lagoon</a> when the wind picks up.</div>
          </li>
          <li class="bc-loc-item">
            <span class="bc-loc-num">2</span>
<div class="bc-loc-body"><strong>5 min to Kalpitiya beach</strong> — by bike or tuk-tuk. Fish markets, Dutch fort and the historical church within easy reach.</div>
          </li>
          <li class="bc-loc-item">
            <span class="bc-loc-num">3</span>
<div class="bc-loc-body"><strong>3 hours from Colombo</strong> — bus to Puttalam, then 40 min tuk-tuk. We can help arrange transfers if needed.</div>

        <h2>Ducks, a Dog and a Visiting Donkey</h2>
        <p>Margarita Village has a <strong>crazy duck family</strong>, a very friendly disabled rescue dog and a donkey that visits from time to time and transfers the most incredible good vibes to everyone who encounters him.</p>  
        <p>We love them so much and we hope you will too. Pets are not just tolerated here — they are part of the family. Bring yours.</p>  
        <p>This is the kind of place that is <strong>not for everyone — and that is exactly the point</strong>. If you want a cookie-cutter resort, this is not it. If you want raw, real, alive Sri Lanka — welcome home.</p>

  <section class="bc-kite-link" id="bc-kite">
    <div class="bc-kite-link-inner">
      <span class="bc-eyebrow">Your kite holiday, complete</span>
      <h2>Kite Lessons at the Lagoon</h2>
      <p>The village is the base. The <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com/kite-school-in-sri-lanka/" target="_blank" style="color:var(--gold-lt);font-weight:700;">Margarita Kite School</a> is where the action happens — 10 minutes away on Kalpitiya lagoon. IKO certified, radio helmet coaching, rescue boat and the flattest water in Asia.</p>  
      <p>Free riders can <strong>jump on the boat to cross to the other side of the lagoon</strong>. Beginners head out with the instructor and rescue boat. Advanced riders join the daily kite trips to Vella Island, Dream Spot and beyond.</p>  

      <div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);border-left:4px solid var(--gold);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 28px;margin:32px 0;text-align:left;">
        <p style="color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>Kite courses from 270€</strong> — all levels, IKO certified, radio helmet coaching, rescue boat included.</p>  
        <p style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);font-size:0.9rem;margin:0;">Beginner, intermediate, advanced and wingfoil lessons available.</p>  
      </div>

      <div class="bc-kite-ctas">
        <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/learning/" class="bc-btn bc-btn-gold">Lesson Info & Prices</a>
        <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com/kite-school-in-sri-lanka/" target="_blank" class="bc-btn bc-btn-ghost">Book Your Course</a>
      </div>
    </div>

  <section class="bc-faq">
    <div class="bc-faq-inner">
      <div class="bc-faq-header">
        <span class="bc-eyebrow" style="color:var(--green);">Your questions answered</span>
        <h2>FAQ — Kite Camp Kalpitiya</h2>
        <p>Everything you need to know before booking your stay at Margarita Village.</p>  
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          How many bungalows are there?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">Margarita Village has 5 rustic wooden bungalows. The camp is intentionally small — this is what creates the community atmosphere and ensures every guest gets personal attention. Because availability is limited, we recommend booking as early as possible, especially for the peak seasons (summer: May–October, winter: December–March).</div>
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          Do I need to kitesurf to stay at the camp?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">Absolutely not. Many guests come to Margarita Village simply to experience Kalpitiya — for the <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/yoga-in-kalpitiya/">yoga</a>, the <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/kalpitiya-dolphin-watching/">dolphin watching</a>, the many <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/things-to-do-in-kalpitiya/">things to do in Kalpitiya</a> and the unique community atmosphere of the camp. That said, with the kite center just 5 minutes by bike and the lagoon right there, many non-kiters end up booking a beginner lesson before their stay is over.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          Is the camp good for solo travellers?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">Margarita Village is one of the best places in Sri Lanka for solo travellers. The small size of the camp means guests naturally meet each other — at the kite center, over meals at the kite school bar, during dolphin watching excursions and on the water. Most solo travellers arrive not knowing anyone and leave with a group of close friends and plans to return together next season.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          What is the difference between the village and the kite center?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">Margarita Village is the rustic bungalow accommodation — your sleeping base, surrounded by coconut trees and garden. The <a href="https://www.margaritakiteschool.com" target="_blank">Margarita Kite School</a> center is 5 minutes away by bike (bikes available at the camp) or 10 minutes on foot — this is where lessons happen, where the rescue boat departs, where the bar and restaurant are and where all guests gather when the wind picks up. The two work together: you sleep at the village, kite and eat at the center.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          Are pets allowed?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">Yes — pets are genuinely welcome at Margarita Village, not just tolerated. The camp already has its own animals (ducks, a rescue dog and an occasional visiting donkey), so the environment is friendly for well-behaved pets. Just let us know when you book so we can ensure the best setup for you and your companion.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          When is the best time to visit?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">Kalpitiya has two kite seasons. The <strong>summer season</strong> (May–October) has strong consistent winds all day — ideal for kiting and exploring. The <strong>winter season</strong> (December–March) has lighter winds from noon, with spectacular mornings for dolphin watching and <a href="https://www.margarita-village.com/yoga-in-kalpitiya/">yoga in Kalpitiya</a>. Both seasons are great stays at the camp. Outside these windows the camp may be quieter and winds less reliable — ask us for current conditions.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="bc-faq-item">
        <button class="bc-faq-q" onclick="bcFaq(this)">
          How do I get to Margarita Village?
          <span class="bc-faq-icon">+</span>
        </button>
        <div class="bc-faq-a">From Colombo or the airport, take a bus or private transfer to Puttalam (around 2.5–3 hours), then a tuk-tuk to Kalpitiya (40 minutes, around 3,500–4,500 LKR). We can help arrange a direct transfer if needed — just contact us when you book. The camp is in the Setthawadiya neighbourhood, 5 minutes from Kalpitiya town and 10 minutes from the kite center on the lagoon.</div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>

  
  <section class="bc-cta-final" 
  
  <section style="width:100%;background:#0c1e3a;padding:70px 60px;">
    <div style="max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:center;">
      <div>
        <span style="font-family:'Dancing Script',cursive;font-size:1.3rem;color:#f5c842;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;">Learn while you're here</span>
        <h2 style="color:#fff;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.3rem);margin-bottom:18px;">Everyone at the Camp Kites.<br />Will You?</h2>
        <p style="font-size:1rem;line-height:1.88;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);margin-bottom:16px;">100% of guests at Margarita Village are either kitesurfing or learning.
